title: Wallets
subtitle: Manage your family's wallets/accounts
deleteConfirm: Delete this wallet? It can only be deleted if it has no transactions yet — you can restore it later from Trash.
seedDefaultsHint: Your family has no wallets yet. Quickly create a "Cash" wallet and a set of common income/expense categories to start recording transactions.
transferSubtitle: An internal transfer is not income or expense; it only changes the balance of the two wallets. You can only move money FROM your own private wallet, TO another member's wallet or a shared one.
transferNoOwnWallet: You don't have a private wallet to transfer from yet — ask the household owner to assign you one ("Owner").
transferNoDestination: There's no wallet to receive the money — you need another member's wallet or a shared one.
transferSameWallet: Source and destination wallets must be different
transferDeleteConfirm: Delete this transfer? Both wallet balances will go back to what they were before the transfer.
ownerOnlyManage: Only the household owner can add, edit or delete wallets.
monthlyHint: Surplus/deficit = income − expense + transfers in − transfers out + balance adjustments for the month. Closing = opening + surplus/deficit.
monthlyLoadFailed: Failed to load monthly wallet balances
nameInvalidChars: A wallet name may only contain letters, digits, spaces and - _ . , & ( ) / ' +
requestSubtitle: Ask another member to move money from their private wallet into yours. The owner gets an email; money only moves once they approve.
requestNoSource: There is no other member's private wallet to ask yet.
requestSent: Request sent — waiting for the owner to approve
requestApproveConfirm: Approve sending {{amount}} to {{name}}? The money moves right away.
lockedRowHint: This month is closed — it can't be edited or deleted
adjustSubtitle: When a balance in the app drifts from reality (a forgotten entry, bank fees...), enter the wallet's REAL balance. The difference only changes the balance: it is neither income nor expense and does not affect budgets or category reports. The family owner can adjust any wallet; members only their own private wallet.
adjustNoWallet: You have no private wallet to adjust — the family owner can adjust any wallet.
adjustNoDifference: The real balance already matches the app — nothing to adjust
adjustConfirm: Adjust the balance of {{wallet}} from {{from}} to {{to}}?
adjustDeleteConfirm: Delete this adjustment? The wallet balance goes back to what it was before.
lockSubtitle: Once a month is closed, nobody can add, edit, delete or restore transactions, transfers or balance adjustments dated in it, so a settled month's balances and budgets can't change behind anyone's back. Only the family owner closes or reopens a month; every close/reopen is recorded.
lockConfirm: Close {{month}}? Everything dated in this month becomes read-only until it is reopened.
unlockConfirm: Reopen {{month}}? Its data becomes editable again.
